'''Christopher Sean Friel''' (born [[October 25]], [[1985]]<ref name="This Week Carpet" />) is an American actor who voices [[Kazuda Xiono]] in ''[[Star Wars Resistance]]''<ref name="Insider 182">[[Star Wars Insider 182|''Star Wars Insider'' 182]]</ref> and [[Asu]] in ''[[Star Wars: Visions]]''.<ref name="The Village Bride">{{Visions|The Village Bride}}</ref> Sean is also known for his roles as [[Wikipedia:Paul Narita|Paul Narita]] in the soap opera [[Wikipedia:Days of Our Lives|''Days of Our Lives'']], Gabriel Waincroft in the police drama [[Wikipedia:Hawaii Five-0|''Hawaii Five-0'']], [[Wikipedia:Dick Grayson|Dick Grayson/Nightwing]] in the [[Wikipedia:DC Comics|DC Comics]] video game [[Wikipedia:Gotham Knights (video game)|''Gotham Knights'']], and Kenji Sato/[[Wikipedia:Ultraman (character)|Ultraman]] in the film [[Wikipedia:Ultraman: Rising|''Ultraman: Rising'']].
